culpritSource.quote: The culprit is really Yosuke Katsuki, while the culprit X never existed. He lied about the time he killed the victim and when he first strangled the victim, he stayed in his house and some hours later he beated him with a pipe to make the police think there's a second murder that murdered the victim hours before the time Katsuki said to have murdered the victim. The evidence is that the door lock has been changed in the morning before the murder, so Katsuki should have not been able to enter the house even with spare key. He is also spotted by security camera at Sebundai Station before 1 PM.
culpritSource.cleanNote: 原文 'The culprit is really Yosuke Katsuki, while the culprit X never existed.' 去掉副词 really

summary.en:
A man is arrested for the murder of his rival. He confesses but his description of how the murder was done didn´t match with the real situation. Is that really the case, or there's another culprit?

Location: Odawara house, Sebundai Town
